notes: New: an Archive list - keep items you're out of without deleting them (archive from the item menu; find them under the archive icon at the top of the Stash List, and as 'Add from archive' on the shopping list; buying one brings it back in stock). You can now also type your own units, like 'dozen'. Searching the Stash List for something you don't have offers an 'Add it' button with the name filled in, moving an item to the shopping list no longer caps at how many you have, and tapping a quantity field now selects it so typing replaces the number.
